description: This file contains symbolic registrations and utility functions for exporting PyTorch models to ONNX format, specifically related to operator definitions and conversions for ONNX opset 8. It manages mappings of PyTorch operations to their ONNX equivalents and handles various operator versions.

methods.name: _interpolate(name, dim, interpolate_mode)
methods.description: Creates a symbolic function for the ONNX 'Upsample' operation with different modes (nearest, linear, trilinear). Handles attribute extraction and shape calculations for interpolation.

methods.name: __interpolate( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, size, scale_factor, mode, align_corners, recompute_scale_factor, antialias, )
methods.description: Defines the symbolic implementation of the 'interpolate' function in ONNX, handling various input conditions and scale/size parameters.

methods.name: _try_cast_integer_to_float(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, *args)
methods.description: Attempts to cast integer tensors to float if needed for certain operators, warning if inputs are integer but operators expect floating point types.

methods.name: _cast_to_type(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, to_type)
methods.description: Casts input tensor to a specified ONNX type.

methods.name: _comparison_operator(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, other, op_name)
methods.description: Defines a comparison operator (e.g., gt, lt) with potential type casting.

methods.name: gt(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, other)
methods.description: Implements the 'greater than' comparison operation for ONNX export.

methods.name: lt(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, other)
methods.description: Implements the 'less than' comparison operation for ONNX export.

methods.name: bmm(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, other)
methods.description: Batch matrix multiplication with type casting considerations.

methods.name: matmul(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, other)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication, calling 'bmm'.

methods.name: prelu(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, weight)
methods.description: Implements the PReLU activation function with support for input and weight type handling.

methods.name: mm(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, other)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication with support for known scalar types.

methods.name: addmm(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, mat1, mat2, beta, alpha)
methods.description: Performs addmm operation with potential type casting.

methods.name: flatten(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, start_dim, end_dim)
methods.description: Implements tensor flattening over specified dimensions, with optional casting to integer types.

methods.name: _constant_fill(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, sizes, dtype: int, const_value)
methods.description: Creates a constant-filled tensor with specified size, data type, and fill value.

methods.name: empty( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, sizes, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False, memory_format=None, )
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor; routed to zeros with default initialization.

methods.name: empty_like( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False, memory_format=None, )
methods.description: Creates an empty tensor like the input, routed to zeros_like.

methods.name: zeros(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, sizes, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False)
methods.description: Creates a tensor filled with zeros.

methods.name: zeros_like( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False, memory_format=None, )
methods.description: Creates a tensor of zeros with shape like input.

methods.name: ones(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, sizes, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False)
methods.description: Creates a tensor filled with ones.

methods.name: ones_like( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False, memory_format=None, )
methods.description: Creates a tensor of ones like the input.

methods.name: full( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, sizes, value, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False )
methods.description: Creates a tensor filled with a specified value.

methods.name: full_like( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, fill_value, dtype, layout, device, pin_memory=False, memory_format=None, )
methods.description: Creates a tensor like input, filled with a specified value.

methods.name: repeat(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, repeats)
methods.description: Repeats the tensor along specified dimensions.

methods.name: symbolic_fn(g, input, output_size, *args)
methods.description: unavailable
